content.text: {"core": "Change ends what has completed. In Faith, it operates on the willed suspension that holds a stance in place: the ending that would release the held position and let the reversal resolve. Too Little, the ending barely reaches the suspension, so the stance stays hung past the point its holding yields anything. The structure carries a fixed posture the process no longer feeds.", "sheetLine": "The hold has stopped paying; the posture stays fixed while the release never lands."}
